title: ICT User Support Technician
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/3512), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: A user says their laptop can't print. Walk us through the questions you would ask and the checks you would make.
questions.source: eMASCO 3512, task 1: Menjawab pertanyaan pengguna berhubung dengan operasi perisian dan perkakasan untuk menyelesaikan masalah.

questions.text: Tell us about a time you found an error in a system by watching how it behaved. How did you confirm what was wrong?
questions.source: eMASCO 3512, task 2: Memasukkan arahan dan mengesan ralat serta memerhatikan pemfungsian sistem untuk mengesahkan operasi yang betul.

questions.text: How would you prepare a new computer for a staff member who starts tomorrow? What would you set up, and in what order?
questions.source: eMASCO 3512, task 5: Mempersiapkan peralatan untuk kegunaan kakitangan…
